title: Solution Analysis of Tensor Equation $\mathcal{A} \ltimes \mathcal{X} \ltimes \mathcal{B}= \mathcal{C}$ via Semi Tensor Product with t-product
summary: Tensor equations involving both left and right tensor operators arise naturally in applications where multidimensional data are coupled through transformations acting from both sides. Motivated by the need to analyze such equations, this manuscript investigates a detailed solution analysis of $\mathcal{A}\ltimes \mathcal{X}\ltimes \mathcal{B} = \mathcal{C}$ via the semi-tensor product with the $t$-product.
